themePages.listTitle: Themes with a point of view.
themePages.listDescription: Choose a complete visual language for your product. Every Vesuvius theme ships with light and dark tokens, semantic status colors and matching UI chrome.
themePages.detailDescription: A complete visual language for product surfaces, interaction states and interface chrome.
themePages.shapeDescription: Soft radii, quiet shadows and layered surfaces keep the system cohesive.
themePages.showcaseTitle: Components, charts, bento and marketing on the same tokens.

lava.description: Warm volcanic stone, cream surfaces and a burnt-orange action color.

stripe.description: A white canvas, deep navy ink and a focused violet-blurple action color.

vercel.description: Pure black, airy white surfaces and sharp developer-product chrome.

supabase.description: Bright emerald-mint energy with friendly technical surfaces.

claude.mood: A reading-room glow for thoughtful products
claude.description: Warm parchment, terracotta heat and scholarly product chrome.

amber-minimal.description: A clean white palette with a focused amber-gold primary.

claymorphism.description: Soft dimensional clay surfaces with a bold violet action color.

alpine.mood: A premium SaaS palette with a pulse
alpine.description: Deep alpine-night ink, confident cobalt structure and coral warmth on a blush canvas.

aubergine.mood: Collaborative energy with a friendly edge
aubergine.description: Slack-inspired aubergine navigation, expressive violet surfaces and bright blue actions.

hero.title: A complete React + TypeScript component kit — Radix UI underneath, Tailwind CSS on top, ten color themes out of the box.
hero.description: 65 components, live previews, and full documentation — built entirely with Vesuvius UI.

tabsHint.atoms: The smallest building blocks — a single element, styled and accessible on its own.
tabsHint.molecules: A few atoms combined into one reusable unit with its own behavior.
tabsHint.organisms: Complete, self-contained sections built from molecules and atoms.
tabsHint.templates: Layout patterns that arrange organisms into a page skeleton — the shape, not the content.
tabsHint.pages: Real screens from a full product built entirely with Vesuvius UI, populated with real content.
